parameters.instructions: LinkedIn data for CSR research. Every call goes through the n8n workflows: results are cached for 90 days, capped per account per day, paced 30-90 s apart and saved to Postgres. Profile calls take 1-5 minutes when not cached; do not call tools in parallel. A 429 means the daily cap is reached: stop and tell the user.

parameters.toolDescription: Get one LinkedIn person's full profile (every job and degree) as JSON. Returns the cached copy when it is under 90 days old.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ url: $fromAI('url', 'LinkedIn profile URL, https://www.linkedin.com/in/<id>/', 'string'), force: $fromAI('force', 'true only when the user asks for a fresh scrape despite a cached copy', 'boolean', false) }) }}

parameters.toolDescription: Find people at a company who own or influence CSR spend (CSR, sustainability, ESG, foundation, senior HR) via Sales Navigator. Returns leads scored 5-10 with a reason, and saves them.
parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ company: $fromAI('company', 'Company name as on LinkedIn', 'string'), cin: $fromAI('cin', 'Indian CIN of the company if known, else empty', 'string', '') }) }}
